annotations.text:
Final page in E's language (flat black civic, Deichman-style chips and covers, Oodi-style 'open now' line and stats, Seattle-style utility row).

Sections, top to bottom: utility row → nav → SQL search row → hero with the indexers table → 'The gap' notice → 01 How it works (manifest / operator / SQL) → On the shelves now (one cover per table) → 02 Reliability with the chaos lab → Latest events → 03 Benchmarks → 04 Compare → Get started → footer.

All copy and numbers are from arckive.org today. Placeholders to confirm: the eurc-arc and dex-pool rows in the indexers table, row counts on the covers, the Views / Control tables tabs, and the four 'Latest events' cards (sample rows).

The phone artboard is the same file at 390px: nav links collapse, grids stack, the cover row and tables scroll sideways.

What was borrowed, and from where (checked on the live sites, 10 Sep 2026):

• Oodi Helsinki — the 'Open today 08:00–21:00 · All opening times' line under the header, and the big-number stats block.
• Deichman Oslo — black-on-white with flat pastel chips (peach #fbcd83, salmon #fb9688, teal #085c58, beige #dac9bc), 5px radii, event cards with a coloured date badge, a cover grid with title/author under each cover, black footer.
• British Library — off-white #f5f3ef, warm near-black #28261b, a 68px LIGHT (300) headline, 'What do you want to do today?' pastel pill tiles, one family (Hind).
• Seattle Public Library — two-tier header (utility row + main nav), a service-alert strip, a search block as a first-class element.
• NYPL — utility links above the nav, dark grey footer with plain link columns.

History: five directions in round one (A Stacks, B Catalogue, C Reading Room, D Wayfinding, E Night Stacks). Round two rebuilt C and E from real library-site patterns. E was picked; the final build is on page 1.
